## The problem

What is hard or missing today? Describe the situation, not just the solution.

## The idea

What should change, in plain words.

## Why it matters

Who does this help, and how? (Citizens asking questions, contributors, maintainers - be specific.)

## Scope check

- [ ] This does not change how answers are grounded in official sources.
- [ ] If it touches the answering pipeline, I have read `PROJECT_ARCHITECTURE.md` and `DECISIONS.md`.

## Extra context

Links, sketches, or related issues. If a number appears anywhere in this request, it must be one measured from the running system - see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
